name: Original palace — internal dome and support sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "PAL-DOME-INNER-001 — Original palace — internal dome and support sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Missing dome underside, arch support and transition construction; preserve original palace marble and source dome grammar

PAL-DOME-INNER-001-S01 — Dome interior wedge. Dimensions W,D,H [12, 12, 16]m proposed. One hollow curved dome wedge with ivory underside, rose stone edges, delicate gold rib, upper lip and lateral seam faces; inside curvature follows original bulbous dome, no exterior purple roof glued onto underside.

PAL-DOME-INNER-001-S02 — Supporting arch bay. Dimensions W,D,H [12, 3, 18]m proposed. One open pointed interior arch with two slender clustered piers, inner arch soffit visible, gold ribs and ivory/rose marble. Real passage, no opaque infill.

PAL-DOME-INNER-001-S03 — Square to circular transition. Dimensions W,D,H [12, 12, 8]m proposed. One corner transition from square hall walls to circular dome drum, curved supporting pendentive surface and open arch below; show section and top contact. Continuous realistic thickness.

PAL-DOME-INNER-001-S04 — Drum interior gallery bay. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 4, 10]m proposed. One curved interior gallery bay with slender piers, small pointed windows, source gold and rose/ivory trim, railing separate, top rim to dome. Clear hollow interior.
